spells/mineralize-warrior-3511.name: Mineralize Warrior
spells/mineralize-warrior-3511.effectSummary: After a 1-hour casting, transforms one willing humanoid with no more Hit Dice than you into a mineral warrior. The subject must remain restrained in a coffinlike stone enclosure during the casting, so you cannot target yourself. The subject permanently gains the Mineral Warrior template and is compelled to serve you for one year and one day, after which it is free. Across this spell and other effects that give you control of earth-subtype creatures, you can control at most 2 Hit Dice of mineral warriors per caster level; if a new casting exceeds that limit, the new creature is controlled and you choose enough previously controlled mineral warriors to release. Material cost is gems and expensive minerals worth at least 500 gp per Hit Die created; XP cost is 250 XP per Hit Die. The template's detailed statistics remain an external reference.

spells/spell-flower-4205.name: Spell Flower
spells/spell-flower-4205.effectSummary: For 1 round per caster level, you can hold the charge of one touch spell in each arm or forelimb. Each touch spell occupies a different limb and is discharged only if that limb touches something or is used to cast another spell. Casting a spell with somatic components forces you to use a limb and lose one held touch spell of your choice, though if the new spell is itself a touch spell its charge can immediately occupy the freed limb. You can deliver touch spells normally and, because multiple limbs count as armed, can make an off-hand touch-spell attack in the same round using normal two-weapon fighting penalties. Spell-like and supernatural abilities do not interfere with held charges. When Spell Flower ends, the most recently cast touch spell remains held and all other held charges dissipate.

spells/spider-curse-1223.name: Spider Curse
spells/spider-curse-1223.effectSummary: Transforms one Medium or smaller humanoid into a driderlike creature under your mental control for 1 day per caster level. The subject gains a drider's speed, natural armor, bite attack, and poison, plus +4 Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. It retains Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, level/class, hit points despite Constitution changes, alignment, base attack bonus, and base saves; the new physical scores can alter final AC, attacks, and saves. Equipment that fits the drider body continues to function: upper-body items are retained, while leg, foot, and whole-body items are subsumed and stop functioning. Its bite poison has Fortitude DC 16 + your Wisdom bonus and deals 1d6 temporary Strength damage as both initial and secondary damage. Your control functions like Dominate Person and remains telepathic while the subject stays within range. Unlike Polymorph Other, this printing does not heal damage or cause disorientation.

spells/spiderbind-331.name: Spiderbind
spells/spiderbind-331.effectSummary: Slows one spider or spiderlike creature per caster level, all within 30 feet of each other, for 1 round per caster level. A failed Fortitude save limits the creature to a single move or standard action each turn, prevents full-round actions, imposes -1 on attacks, AC, and Reflex saves, and halves speed. In addition, any attack that would normally deliver poison no longer delivers poison, while its other effects still occur. While you merely have Spiderbind prepared, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on saves against poison. The source explicitly includes araneas, bebiliths, chitines, choldriths, driders, ettercaps, myrlochars, phase spiders, retrievers, and yochlols and points to Underdark for a broader spiderkind list. spells/transcribe-symbol-1597.name: Transcribe Symbol
spells/transcribe-symbol-1597.effectSummary: Protects your hand so you can touch and remove one untriggered magical symbol such as Glyph of Warding or Symbol and hold it like a touch spell. Picking it up requires a caster-level check DC 20 + the stored spell's level; failure triggers the symbol. On success, you can place it on an appropriate surface, not a creature, as a standard action; it then functions normally with its original trigger conditions. If concentration lapses while it is stored, it triggers on you alone even if you would not normally satisfy its trigger. The original symbol's saving throw and spell resistance apply.
